author_role: Root engineering adjudication; not new human approval or independent preregistration

basis.original_gate_question: On the actual deployed family, does a target hit by native FP16 disappear in q_all and return for the same target under the predeclared G1 restoration?

primary_scope: Conditional existence of same-target recovery in the authenticated deployed G1-restoration configuration, including its compiler realization. This is not identification of a pure G1 arithmetic mechanism.
required_source_and_native_controls: All six trained source weights/biases and nonquantized source node op/attribute/initializer identities are authenticated. Only predefined QDQ masks and authenticated semantics-preserving code-Clip rewrites differ.
Every remaining quantizer retains its frozen scale/zero-point/axis/range. No calibration, selection, image/label, group or threshold changes.

All88 weighted source operations are covered by unchanged actual precision, fusion and weight-attribution rules. INT8 input/weight formats require named arithmetic evidence or the separately authenticated own-runtime/SASS evidence branch.

Record actual nonquantized floating input/output formats, reported compute attributes, source-to-native fusion and implementation differences wherever inspector provides them. Do not infer exact compute arithmetic solely from IO formats or names.

q_all versus G1 restoration shares the frozen NONE/INT8+FP16/TF32-off build policy, device/runtime and full-graph input/output contract; source masks, actual formats and complete source lineage identify the tested deployment interventions.

floating_metadata_classes.MATCHED_REPORTED_FLOAT_METADATA: Same relevant reported floating formats and accounted source operation; no stronger bitwise arithmetic equivalence implied.
floating_metadata_classes.DOCUMENTED_DEPLOYMENT_REALIZATION_DIFFER: An authenticated same-source graph with the predefined quantization/restoration treatment realizes different floating boundaries, pointwise partition, implementation or fusion. Retain the exact difference and classify NOT_PURE_ARITHMETIC_CONTROL. This limits mechanism attribution; it is not automatically failure of the deployed-configuration existence question.
floating_metadata_classes.UNAUTHENTICATED_SOURCE_RANGE_POLICY_OR_F: Extra nonquantized source edits, changed remaining quantizers, undisclosed policy changes, unknown weighted source attribution or unaccounted mixed-group fusion are engineering gaps. No primary eligibility PASS.
floating_metadata_classes.MAPPING_UNAVAILABLE: Preserve missing metadata. Constant/shape folding may be accounted statically, but unknown weighted computation, output semantics or input provenance cannot be waived.

explicit_known_controls_and_limits: FP16 control INT8 enablement is false; quantized members enable it. All use FP16 true, NONE constraints, TF32 false, same workspace/timing/bindings. Do not claim all flags identical or isolate the sole effect of bit width from this compiler policy difference.

The FP16 control has FP16 DFL Softmax/decode while q_all and inspected restorations realize FP32 there. Record this baseline deployment difference; do not describe all F-minus-Q misses as uniquely caused by integer rounding.

q_all and inspected G1 restoration share FP32 DFL/decode, but unchanged source model.6 SiLU/residual partitions can still differ in reported floating formats. Record those differences, rather than assigning every such difference to a proven local G1 mechanism.

Different native layer counts, weighted-operation fusion partitions, tactic names, pointwise partitions or floating epilogues do not by themselves invalidate the broad deployed-configuration existence comparison. They do prevent a pure G1 arithmetic-cause claim.

No additional bridge engine has been built under this policy. Earlier bridge ideas were unexecuted proposals. A later bridge is a separately frozen diagnostic and cannot replace the first150-image result after observing it.

adjudication.primary_positive: Only if all engineering/reference/input/evaluator controls hold and at least one target belongs to (F minus Q) intersect R_G1. Label local conditional deployed recovery existence, not superiority or pure module causality.
adjudication.primary_negative: Valid complete results with no added miss or no G1 same-target rescue are scientific nonreproduction; do not substitute a combined group.
adjudication.net_benefit: Always disclose collateral losses and net recovery. Nonzero existence with negative net does not imply useful recovery.
adjudication.auxiliary_bidirectional: Requires engineering eligibility and same-target q_only damage/rescue overlap; report as weak deployment support only.

execution_authorization: Interpretation policy only. Exact engine/input/evaluator/reference identities and budgets must still be frozen in the final dataset execution contracts before model outputs.
